This comic started on July 17th, 2016 and stopped on March 22nd, 2022.
The comic hasn't had any new pages for over 4+ years and the artist has shown no signs or plans on ever coming back to finish this so I'm uploading all the pages of the so far as well as some miscellaneous images that relate to the characters.
